This device cannot run the game yet

The game needs WebGPU, which this device's "Android System WebView" does not provide.

• Android 12 or newer is required.
• Update "Android System WebView" (and Chrome) to the latest version in the Play Store, then start the game again.

WebGPU could not use this device's graphics chip (GPU).

• Android 12 or newer and a recent Qualcomm Adreno or ARM Mali GPU are required.
• Update "Android System WebView" (and Chrome) to the latest version in the Play Store, then start the game again.
The graphics process stopped several times in a row. Close other apps and try again. If it keeps happening, this device may not have enough memory or GPU support for the game.
The game could not be loaded
The game files inside the app could not be opened. Please reinstall the app.
